newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian share market closes at record high.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian share market closes at record high.

text.p: The Australian share market finished at a record close on Tuesday with the All Ordinaries index ending up 11.7 points at 2,424.6.
The index also set a record intra-day high on Tuesday of 2,426.5, exceeding the previous high of 2,416.8 set on December 30 this year by 9.7 points.
The share market barometer's previous record closing high was set on Monday when the index ended at 2,412.9, a gain of 17.3 points on the day.
